subject: Request for one-time service recovery allowance — AcquiMetrics latency incident
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@acquimetrics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Increased latency during Friday batch window (ticket #8769)

Hi Jasmine,

Our ops noticed a large spike in token latency between 02:10–08:45 UTC on Friday that impacted multiple production jobs (priority pipelines for our reconciliation batch). We saw tail latencies spike to ~1.2s/token and several timeouts; this caused delayed deliveries and a downstream failure in our ETL that required manual intervention.

This was a business-impacting window for us — estimate attached shows at least 6 hours of degraded throughput during our busiest batch. Please advise: what happened, what’s fixed, and what remediation/credit Redwood can offer for the disruption. We’ve opened support ticket #8769 and attached a short extract of the logs.

We’d like a commercial remediation offer while we decide on longer-term architecture changes.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Operations, AcquiMetrics
emily@acquimetrics.com

Attachment: acq_latency_window_log.csv

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@acquimetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:35:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Increased latency during Friday batch window (ticket #8769)

Hi Emily —

I’m very sorry to hear about the impact. I’ve escalated to our SREs and Marissa (CS) is pulled in to coordinate the outage timeline and remediation steps. Preliminary notes from the team: we had an autoscaler timing mismatch on the reserved pool during a sudden burst from a small subset of your jobs; kernel selection latencies plus cold KV-cache entries amplified the issue for longer sequences.

Next steps we’re taking now:
- Marissa will assemble a concise outage timeline and affected routes.
- SREs will scope root cause and mitigation (KV warming + autoscaler rule tweak).
- I’ll propose a commercial remediation package (credit + temporary premium support) and route for approval.

Would you be open to a one-time service recovery allowance while we complete RCA and rollout fixes? I can propose a draft offer (credit value + one month complimentary Premium) and route for internal signoff.

I’ll send an internal note to Markus and Lauren for approval thresholds.

— Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:12:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Increased latency during Friday batch window (ticket #8769)

Adding impact assessment and suggested customer language.

Summary of impact (from ops):
- Window: 2025-07-11 02:10 — 2025-07-11 08:45 UTC
- Symptoms: elevated p95/p99 latencies, intermittent 504s for long-sequence generate calls, increased tokens billed during retries
- Affected routes: /v1/generate (custom model routing) — estimate ~4% of monthly tokens

Suggested commercial remediation (initial recommendation):
1) One-time invoice credit equivalent to 20% of July invoice for AcquiMetrics (estimated $14k based on usage).
2) One complimentary month of Premium Support (priority SLAs + proactive runbook review) to cover the next renewal cycle.

Customer-facing wording (suggested):
"We apologize for the disruption during your batch window on July 11. Redwood has identified the contributing factors and implemented immediate mitigations. As a gesture of goodwill and to help stabilize your operations, we will issue a one-time credit on your July invoice and provide one month of Premium Support at no charge while we complete additional hardening."

Attachments: outage_timeline.xlsx (detailed timestamps and affected job IDs)

As Jasmine noted, please advise if this is within acceptable approval limits or whether Finance/Revenue signoff is required for a larger concession. I recommend the 20% credit + 1 month free as a reasonable balance to retain trust while limiting revenue impact.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 14:40:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Increased latency during Friday batch window (ticket #8769)

Thanks for the summary, Marissa.

Finance perspective: we need a concrete cap and GL impact before signoff. Based on the numbers provided, a one-time credit of up to $18,000 plus one complimentary month of Premium Support is approvable within Revenue Ops delegation. Anything exceeding $25,000 will need executive (VP/GM) approval and will be routed through Legal for any SLA amendment language.

Please confirm: 1) final estimated credit amount, 2) whether the complimentary month affects an annual contract term (do we extend the term or credit future invoices), and 3) expected churn risk if we don’t provide concession. If you can get the customer to agree to the credit + 1 month (not extending the contracted term), we can process the credit in July billing.

— Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 16:05:09 -0700
Subject: Re: Increased latency during Friday batch window (ticket #8769)

Good summary — we should move quickly. Jasmine, please prepare a short memo for exec approval that includes: final technical RCA bullet points, estimated customer revenue at risk, requested concession (I recommend we ask for $18k credit + 1 month Premium), and the win-back language. I’ve drafted a one-paragraph customer note (attached) and a proposed DocuSign flow for acceptance; if the customer signs the acceptance, Finance can apply the credit to the July invoice.

If AcquiMetrics pushes for more than $25k, escalate to RVP (Karthik) for ad-hoc approval. For now, authorize the $18,000 cap and complimentary month pending the memo.

Proposed customer-facing offer (short):
"Redwood will issue a one-time credit of $18,000 to AcquiMetrics and provide one complimentary month of Premium Support. We will not adjust the contracted term; the credit will be applied to the July invoice upon acceptance of this offer via DocuSign."

Marissa — please confirm you will send the outage timeline and the DocuSign link to Emily and then let me know once she acknowledges. Jasmine — please add the memo to the HubSpot deal (link below) so we have the paper trail.

— Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
